review.notes: Code fences balanced (two python blocks). Full normalized text-layer diff of all 28 physical pages against the OCR Markdown; the unmatched residue on pages 3-7, 9, 13-17 and 25-26 is reflowed display math (LaTeX-equivalent) and figure-internal axis/legend text. Pages 1, 20, 22 and 23 were rendered to verify every patch (footnote blocks at 300 dpi, reference entries and title at 220 dpi). Restored footnote bodies keep the printed text; the GitHub/HuggingFace icon glyphs printed before the page-1 footnote URLs are decorative marks and were not transcribed.

unresolved.evidence: Axis ticks and fit-line annotations from Figures 1/3/5 (e.g. '32K', '256K', 'PFLOP/s-days', 'MLA: 2.3092 × C^-0.0536') appear in the PDF text layer and are partially interleaved with body text in OCR order; the figures are embedded as images, so the stray tick text is noise rather than lost content.
